description:
Sweeping across the entire nation as an overnight sensation, the revolutionary sleep aid “Daydream” promised users the impossible: the ability to live out their deepest fantasies and wildest romances inside their dreams. For a while, society willingly surrendered to the blissful illusion.

Until the news reports began breaking.

What started as isolated rumors of fatal side effects rapidly spiraled into an uncontrollable catastrophe. The drug had unleashed the “Illusion Virus,” trapping victims inside lethal hallucinations and blurring the line between waking reality and waking nightmare as infection rates skyrocketed, plunging the country into sheer chaos.

Trapped inside the walls of a locked-down school as the outside world collapses, Lee Sol bands together with a group of surviving students. Surrounded by the infected and cut off from help, they must fight their way out of the school—and figure out how to survive in a harsh reality where everyone else has lost their minds to a dream.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=857700), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=15038651)
